task.title: Build a pure bounded retry recovery decision matrix

scope.owned_layer: Pure immutable recovery decision over the merged exact V3 failure aggregate and normalized progress generation.
scope.not_changing: Failure/progress recording, consumption, failure clearing, counters, canonical state, queues, reservations, workers, worktree leases, provider policy, configuration, dispatch, product controllers, and live services.

contract.identity: Current task id/owner/reviewer, target owner, normalized logical provider, latest failure generation, and exact reviewer progress generation must agree; owner and reviewer remain independent.
contract.reviewer_progress: Only governed reviewer reopen strictly newer than the failure qualifies; a bound head equals rejected_head and an unbound reopen uses ABSENT.
contract.one_shot: Proposes failure-recovery:<sha256> over exact task/provider/failure/progress identities and denies a previously consumed token without mutating the supplied set.
contract.occupancy: Exact-task active worker, pending/started queue event, delivery reservation, or active worktree lease denies.
contract.provider_gate: Exact logical provider must be ready with auth_paused=false, quota_paused=false, and policy_paused=false.
contract.output: Nested MappingProxyType containing allow/deny, stable reason code, exact identities, prior failure facts, qualifying event, and proposed token.
contract.purity: No input, canonical state, runtime state, queue, reservation, worker, lease, provider state, counter, or audit mutation.

deny_matrix: empty, unknown, terminal, timeout, parse_error, exit_code, auth, quota, policy, overlap, dirty_worktree, wrong_branch, wrong_task, or provider_unready failure kind
cross failure generation, task, or provider progress
stale progress or same rejected owner-commit replay
changed owner or reviewer, wrong target, or owner equal to reviewer
owner commit in place of independent reviewer progress
active exact-task worker, pending/started queue event, reservation, or worktree lease

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=.orchestrator .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m pytest -q .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py -k 'FailureStreakV3 or FailureStreakActivityNormalizerV3 or FailureStreakRecoveryDecisionV2 or immediate_start_failure_captures_v3 or active_worker_failure_captures_v3 or generic_exit_captures_v3 or reconcile_runtime_retries_missing_owner_with_bounded_evidence or reconcile_runtime_uses_log_failure_for_missing_process_quota or reconcile_runtime_uses_log_failure_for_copilot_monthly_quota or failure_streaks_aggregate_dispatch_slots'

review.note: Owner-authored evidence only. Independent review of the final exact PR head is required before approval or merge.
